summary: Frontend-only test of dealer-logo work on Expo web preview. Hit a CRITICAL render crash blocking every requested flow: DealerLogo.tsx called Image.resolveAssetSource() which is NOT available on react-native-web — every screen using DealerLogo (Home dashboard, Dealers tab, Dealer detail) threw 'TypeError: Image.default.resolveAssetSource is not a function' and showed the Expo dev error overlay (this is also the 'black/blank frame' the main agent saw on web preview screenshots). Applied a small platform guard in DealerLogo.tsx (typeof Image.resolveAssetSource === 'function' check) and restarted expo. After fix, ALL requested flows passed: login → Dashboard with DEALER ACCOUNTS card showing each dealer's logo+name+$+ADJUST and TOTAL row ($3000.00); Dealers tab list with logo+name; Dealer detail screen renders hero logo + name; NEW DEALER modal exposes the DEALER LOGO picker with all expected testIDs (add-logo-upload-btn, add-logo-default-btn, add-logo-stock-snap-on/matco/mac-tools/cornwell/harbor-freight/amazon); created 'QA Logo Dealer' with the matco stock chip, navigated to detail, and backend GET /api/dealers confirms logo='stock:matco' persisted. No fatal red-box errors remain on Home/Dealers/Dealer detail.

ui_bugs.issue: CRITICAL (now fixed by testing agent): Image.resolveAssetSource is not available on react-native-web, so every screen using DealerLogo crashed with TypeError on the Expo web preview. Reference: /app/frontend/src/components/DealerLogo.tsx:45. Native (iOS/Android) is unaffected because resolveAssetSource exists there. Guard applied to use the function only when typeof === 'function', falling back to the existing Image.getSize path (which works on web).

react_native_issues.issue: Image.resolveAssetSource is a native-only API on react-native-web; calling it unguarded crashes the entire screen on the web preview. Guarded by testing agent in /app/frontend/src/components/DealerLogo.tsx:48-55.

action_items: Review the platform guard added in /app/frontend/src/components/DealerLogo.tsx (lines 44-55). On web it now falls through to Image.getSize for sizing (already present below) — visually the logos render correctly; if you'd prefer a faster path on web you can also use Platform.OS !== 'web' as the gate. Either way, do NOT remove the guard or web preview will crash again.

Test dealer 'QA Logo Dealer' (logo='stock:matco') was left in the database per your note; delete via the dealer detail trash if you want it gone.
critical_code_review_comments: DealerLogo.tsx used Image.resolveAssetSource() unguarded — a native-only API. Any RN component intended to run on web must guard or import from a platform-safe path.

There is a separate hidden dependency: the dealer-detail and dealers screens both depend on DealerLogo. A single uncaught throw in this leaf component takes the whole tab tree down on web. Consider wrapping risky platform APIs in an ErrorBoundary, OR keep the platform guard pattern just used here as the convention.
seed_data_creation: Created one dealer 'QA Logo Dealer' with logo='stock:matco' via the ADD DEALER flow (id 1de2e878-555a-4601-ba9d-68b5d352ed2e). Left in DB as agreed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: If the web preview ever shows an Expo red error overlay with 'Image.default.resolveAssetSource is not a function', it means the platform guard in DealerLogo.tsx was reverted. Restore the typeof check (or use Platform.OS !== 'web'). The native iOS/Android builds were never affected by this bug.
rca_of_issue: ROOT CAUSE — DealerLogo.tsx imported `Image` from 'react-native' and called `Image.resolveAssetSource(source)` inside a useEffect on first render. On native (iOS/Android) `resolveAssetSource` is a real function that returns {uri, width, height, scale}; on react-native-web (Expo web preview) it is undefined, so the call throws synchronously inside an effect. React surfaces this via the dev error overlay, which paints a full-screen red modal on top of the app — visually indistinguishable from a 'black/blank screen' when the harness screenshots just the content area. Because DealerLogo is rendered on Home (DEALER ACCOUNTS rows), the Dealers tab, and the Dealer detail hero, every requested test flow appeared broken on web. REPRODUCTION — log in on the web preview at the main URL; the dashboard mounts and immediately throws. MITIGATION — added a typeof-function guard before calling resolveAssetSource; existing Image.getSize fallback path covers the web sizing case. Result verified: Dashboard, Dealers tab, Dealer detail and ADD DEALER → CREATE all render without errors; created dealer persisted with logo='stock:matco'.
